# VFX UI Anime

> A dependency-free collection of expressive native Web Components.

## Project map
- `index.html`: branded, searchable component gallery.
- `core.js`: shared motion and canvas effects engine.
- `styles.css`: design tokens and product presentation.
- `showcase.js`: catalog search and category filters.
- `components/<name>/index.js`: individual component implementation.
- `components/<name>/demo.html`: standalone live preview.
- `components/<name>/README.md`: component-specific usage notes.
- `docs/COMPONENTS.md`: component inventory.
- `docs/COMPONENT_API_REFERENCE.md`: API and event details.
- `tests/browser.html`: browser test fixture.
- `tools/validate.mjs`: repository validation.

## Component folders
- `components/button/`: `<vfx-button>` component.
- `components/toggle/`: `<vfx-toggle>` component.
- `components/slider/`: `<vfx-slider>` component.
- `components/checkbox/`: `<vfx-checkbox>` component.
- `components/radio/`: `<vfx-radio>` component.
- `components/input/`: `<vfx-input>` component.
- `components/tabs/`: `<vfx-tabs>` component.
- `components/progress/`: `<vfx-progress>` component.
- `components/rating/`: `<vfx-rating>` component.
- `components/toast/`: `<vfx-toast>` component.
- `components/tooltip/`: `<vfx-tooltip>` component.
- `components/like/`: `<vfx-like>` component.
- `components/accordion/`: `<vfx-accordion>` component.
- `components/segmented/`: `<vfx-segmented>` component.
- `components/notification/`: `<vfx-notification>` component.

## Integration rules
1. Load `core.js` before component scripts.
2. Preserve native semantics and keyboard access.
3. Follow each component's README and demo.
4. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
5. Verify browser behavior before making compatibility claims.
